outcomes: Actual paid permanent cast and controller upkeep mills first. Only an empty library afterward exiles the exact current source and starts the separate mandatory graveyard selection. A departed source does not cancel the return, and no later incarnation is exiled.

Five cards must be selected when available; fewer require every available card, and no graveyard cards creates no choice or draw attempt. Untargeted selection rejects wrong owners and duplicates. First selected is uppermost, and only successfully returned exact library incarnations are reordered.

Graveyard top order stays private under CR401.4. The owner keeps private exact-top knowledge, the opponent gets no private choice/order or top identity. Raw/index branches and restore after parent disposal preserve independent selected orders.

An actual paid tap activates the source and queues its tapped trigger. Top-one inspection offers only a land-to-hand phase for lands, with public hand reveal on success. Declining transitions to a separate optional graveyard phase; a nonland starts directly in that phase. Two declines leave the original exact top card and retain its private knowledge.

Top-one look on an empty library does nothing, including no failed draw. Source departure in response does not cancel inspection. Private fallback stage, candidates and known-top state survive raw/index/restore; wrong actor and illegal selections reject transactionally.
